laws.rule: Under the Toyama Prefecture Mountain Climbing Notification Ordinance, anyone entering the danger zones around Tsurugi-dake between 1 December and 15 May must lodge a climbing notification at least 20 days before (online through Compass or Toyama e-application) and carry the receipt while climbing. From 1 December to 15 April the prefecture asks climbers to cancel or change plans for the special danger zones, and asks solo climbers to cancel.
laws.heading: 富山県登山届出条例

laws.rule: Toyama Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (富山県青少年健全育成条例), art. 18. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
